helpTips.title: Help & tips
helpTips.cardScanBasicsSummary: Point, hold steady, and let the camera do the rest.
helpTips.cardScanBasicsBody:
- Hold the ID or passport steady inside the frame — it **captures automatically** once in focus, no shutter button needed
- If it's too dark, you'll see a warning — tap the **flashlight icon** to turn on the torch
- Scanning an ID card's back side and don't need it? Tap **Skip** to jump straight to review
- Review the extracted details before saving — you can always *retake* a blurry page
- Works with ID cards (front and back), passports, driving licences, and address cards
helpTips.cardScanShortcutTitle: Scan straight from the guest list
helpTips.cardScanShortcutSummary: No need to open the guest profile first.
helpTips.cardScanShortcutBody:
- Tap the **scan icon** at the top-right corner of a guest card to jump straight into the camera
- Already-scanned guests show a different icon, so you can see at a glance who's still missing one
- A quick win during busy check-ins, when every tap counts
helpTips.cardChangeStatusSummary: Move a reservation through check-in and check-out right from your phone.
helpTips.cardChangeStatusBody:
- Tap **Change Status** from the action menu to see the full timeline
- Tap the next status to change — *Confirmed → Check-in → Onboard → Check-out*
- Made a mistake? **Press and hold** an earlier step to revert
helpTips.cardAddNotesSummary: Keep the whole team in the loop.
helpTips.cardAddNotesBody:
- Choose **Reservation** (a guest request) or **Room** (something for housekeeping)
- Reservation notes can be marked **Visible to Housekeeper**
- Room notes can be tagged to specific *dates* of the stay
- Everyone sees notes in real time — no more handwritten logs at the desk
helpTips.cardDeleteNotesSummary: Swipe left on any note to remove it.
helpTips.cardDeleteNotesBody:
- **Swipe a note to the left** to reveal a delete button
- Tap it to remove the note for good
- No separate edit option — fixing a typo means deleting and adding a corrected one
helpTips.cardSearchSummary: Search by name, email, code, or room.
helpTips.cardSearchBody:
- Tap the search bar on Home to look up a reservation by guest **name**/**email**, **reservation code**, or **room**
- Results update as you type
- Tap any result to jump straight into its details
helpTips.cardAutoLockSummary: Set how long the app waits before locking itself.
helpTips.cardAutoLockBody:
- Go to **Settings → Auto-Lock** to pick 10 minutes up to 2 hours
- *Shorter* = more secure on a shared device
- *Longer* = fewer unlock prompts during a busy shift
- Set per device — each phone or tablet can differ
helpTips.cardBiometricUnlockSummary: Unlock with a glance, not a password.
helpTips.cardBiometricUnlockBody:
- Unlock with **Face ID**, **Touch ID**, or your device passcode
- A quick *session lock*, not a sign-out — you won't need to log in again
- No biometrics set up? You'll get the passcode prompt instead
- After a few failed attempts, fall back to signing in with your password
helpTips.cardFeedbackSummary: Spotted a bug or have an idea? Let us know from right inside the app.
helpTips.cardFeedbackBody:
- Tap the **lightbulb icon** on Home, or **Settings → Request a Feature**
- Choose **Feature Request** or **Feedback**
- We read every submission, and may follow up if we have questions
helpTips.cardLanguageSummary: GO speaks your language — change it anytime in Settings.
helpTips.cardLanguageBody: Tap Settings → Language to pick from the available languages. Your choice is remembered on this device.
helpTips.cardOpenInPmsTitle: See what's open in the PMS
helpTips.cardOpenInPmsSummary: Reservations a colleague has open in the desktop PMS show up right on Home.
helpTips.cardOpenInPmsBody: If a reservation is currently open on the desktop PMS, it appears in its own "Open in PMS" section at the top of your arrivals list — so you know what a colleague is working on before you touch it.
